patient.name: 村上愛
patient.setting: 成人；体育教师；曾为马拉松选手。星见 AU 首次专属病例。
patient.setting_en: An adult PE teacher and former marathon runner. An authored first case in the Hoshimi alternate universe.
patient.diagnosis: 主动脉根部及近端升主动脉瘤（未破裂、未夹层）；三叶式主动脉瓣，瓣叶适合保留
patient.diagnosis_en: Aortic root and proximal ascending aortic aneurysms (unruptured, without dissection); tricuspid native aortic valve with suitable leaflets for preservation

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「我还以为体检室弄错了。心电图不是说没什么特别的吗？」
lines.text_en: “I thought the screening clinic had made a mistake. Didn't they say my ECG looked unremarkable?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「心电图和主动脉的形状，是两回事。」
lines.text_en: “An ECG and the shape of your aorta tell us two different things.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「我以前可是跑马拉松的。现在每周还要带学生上体育课呢。」
lines.text_en: “I used to run marathons. I still teach PE every week.”

lines.speaker: doc_emiko
lines.text: 「我们知道。所以我要你先看检查结果。」
lines.text_en: “We know. That's why I want you to look at the imaging first.”

lines.speaker: doc_emiko
lines.text: 「主动脉根部，最大五点三厘米。上面的升主动脉也扩张了。」
lines.text_en: “The aortic root measures five point three centimeters at its widest. The ascending aorta above it is enlarged as well.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……可是我现在一点也不觉得心脏有什么问题啊？」
lines.text_en: “But I don't feel anything wrong with my heart at all.”

lines.speaker: doc_emiko
lines.text: 「所以我们才要在你出现问题之前动手术。」
lines.text_en: “That's exactly why we need to operate before something happens.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「这是说，我现在跑得动，不等于它就是安全的？」
lines.text_en: “So being able to run right now doesn't mean it's safe?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「问题主要在承受血流压力的主动脉壁。它不一定会先给你一个疼痛的警告。」
lines.text_en: “The problem is in the aortic wall that bears the pressure of each heartbeat. It may not give you a warning in the form of pain.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「我平时还教学生，身体不舒服一定要及时说。结果我的身体连招呼都不打。」
lines.text_en: “I tell my students to speak up when something feels wrong. Apparently my own body doesn't believe in giving notice.”

lines.speaker: doc_emiko
lines.text: 「方案是切除病变的主动脉根部和升主动脉，用人工血管重建。」
lines.text_en: “The plan is to remove the diseased aortic root and ascending aorta and reconstruct them with a graft.”

lines.speaker: doc_emiko
lines.text: 「你的主动脉瓣叶条件不错。我们计划保留它。」
lines.text_en: “Your native aortic valve leaflets look suitable. We plan to preserve them.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「换血管，却把瓣膜留下？」
lines.text_en: “Replace the artery, but keep the valve?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「是的。新的人工血管还要和两条冠状动脉的开口重新连接。」
lines.text_en: “Yes. We'll also have to reattach the openings of both coronary arteries to the new graft.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……听起来已经不像我以为的‘心脏修补’了。」
lines.text_en: “That sounds a great deal bigger than the ‘heart repair’ I had imagined.”

lines.speaker: doc_emiko
lines.text: 「正中切开胸骨，建立体外循环。重建根部时，需要暂时让心脏停搏。」
lines.text_en: “We'll open the sternum along the midline and establish cardiopulmonary bypass. During root reconstruction, we'll temporarily arrest the heart.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「停……停搏？是说心脏真的会停下来？」
lines.text_en: “Arrest... You mean my heart will actually stop?”

lines.speaker: doc_emiko
lines.text: 「体外循环会在这段时间维持血液循环。重建完成后，再恢复心脏灌注并评估功能。」
lines.text_en: “The bypass circuit supports your circulation during that interval. After reconstruction, we'll restore blood flow to the heart and assess its function.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「我没想到，教了这么多年人体课，最难懂的例子会是我自己。」
lines.text_en: “After teaching anatomy for so many years, I never expected to become the example I understand the least.”

lines.speaker: doc_emiko
lines.text: 「你不需要背下术式名称。但我会把你要面对的过程完整告诉你。」
lines.text_en: “You don't need to memorize the operation's name. But I will explain the procedure you're consenting to.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「保瓣方案还要在术中再次确认。如果瓣叶条件不合适，团队会按术前说明的备选方案处理。」
lines.text_en: “We will assess the leaflets again during surgery. If preservation isn't appropriate, we'll use the alternative approach explained during consent.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「我知道了。那我先安排好学校的代课。还有……我需要多久不能跑？」
lines.text_en: “All right. I'll arrange someone to cover my classes. And... how long will I be unable to run?”

lines.speaker: doc_emiko
lines.text: 「先把手术和康复做好。关于重返跑道，我们会认真谈，但不会拿猜测给你排训练表。」
lines.text_en: “First, surgery and rehabilitation. We will take your return to running seriously, but we won't write a training plan based on guesses.”

lines.speaker: doc_emiko
lines.text: 「这台由你主刀。我做第一助手。」
lines.text_en: “You'll be the lead surgeon. I'll take first assist.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「主动脉根部再植入。这一次，你打算从哪一处开始教？」
lines.text_en: “An aortic root reimplantation. Where do you plan to begin teaching this time?”

lines.speaker: doc_emiko
lines.text: 「从你自己说出计划开始。」
lines.text_en: “With you explaining the plan yourself.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「先建立体外循环和心肌保护。确认瓣叶后，准备根部和冠状动脉开口，固定人工血管，完成瓣膜与血管重建，最后复跳和脱机。」
lines.text_en: “Establish bypass and myocardial protection. Inspect the leaflets, prepare the root and coronary buttons, secure the graft, complete the valve and vascular reconstruction, then reperfuse and wean from bypass.”

lines.speaker: doc_emiko
lines.text: 「顺序没问题。到了术野里，你得知道什么时候该停下来重看一眼。」
lines.text_en: “The sequence is sound. In the field, you need to know when to stop and look again.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「你会提醒我的。」
lines.text_en: “You'll remind me.”

lines.speaker: doc_emiko
lines.text: 「我会问你问题。答案要你自己给。」
lines.text_en: “I'll ask questions. You'll have to provide the answers.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「听上去比亲自主刀还严格。」
lines.text_en: “That sounds stricter than operating yourself.”

lines.speaker: doc_emiko
lines.text: 「当然。这次握刀的人是你。」
lines.text_en: “Of course. This time, you're the one holding the scalpel.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「坂口医生，等我醒过来……它还是我的心脏吧？」
lines.text_en: “Dr. Sakaguchi, when I wake up... it'll still be my heart, won't it?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「是你的心脏。我们要修好的，是保护它的大血管。」
lines.text_en: “It will still be your heart. We're repairing the major vessel that carries blood from it.”

lines.speaker: doc_emiko
lines.text: 「醒来以后，第一项训练不是跑步。是好好呼吸，按计划恢复。」
lines.text_en: “When you wake up, your first training session won't be running. It will be breathing well and following your recovery plan.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……遵命，御堂教练。」
lines.text_en: “...Yes, Coach Mido.”

lines.speaker: doc_emiko
lines.text: 「手术结束以后，你可以再决定要不要这么叫我。」
lines.text_en: “After the operation, you can decide whether you still want to call me that.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「早上好……我猜这回不能下床给你们示范热身了。」
lines.text_en: “Good morning... I suppose I can't get up and demonstrate a warm-up today.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「今天的训练计划里，没有下床示范这一项。」
lines.text_en: “Getting up to demonstrate isn't on today's training plan.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「那就是还有训练计划了。」
lines.text_en: “So there is a training plan.”

lines.speaker: doc_emiko
lines.text: 「当然有。呼吸训练、止痛、逐步活动。一步都不能跳。」
lines.text_en: “Of course. Breathing exercises, pain control, gradual mobilization. You don't skip steps.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「御堂医生，我以后还能跑步吗？」
lines.text_en: “Dr. Mido, will I ever be able to run again?”

lines.speaker: doc_emiko
lines.text: 「我们做这台手术，最终不是为了让你一辈子躲着运动。」
lines.text_en: “We didn't do this operation so you would spend the rest of your life avoiding exercise.”

lines.speaker: doc_emiko
lines.text: 「我们的目标，是让你的心脏今后还能像从前一样可靠地工作。」
lines.text_en: “Our goal is for your heart to keep working as reliably as it did before.”

lines.speaker: doc_emiko
lines.text: 「等胸骨愈合、康复和复查都合格，我希望有一天能让你重新站上马拉松跑道。」
lines.text_en: “Once your sternum has healed and your rehabilitation and follow-up results are good, I hope we can get you back onto a marathon course one day.”

lines.speaker: doc_emiko
lines.text: 「只是那时候，配速和心率要按我们商量好的计划来。不能再只靠自己的感觉。」
lines.text_en: “But then your pace and heart rate will have to follow the plan we agree on. You can't rely on how you feel alone.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「这可比以前教练给我的训练计划严格多了。」
lines.text_en: “That's even stricter than the training plans my old coach used to give me.”

lines.speaker: doc_emiko
lines.text: 「你的教练不用替你重新接上冠状动脉。」
lines.text_en: “Your old coach never had to reattach your coronary arteries.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……说得也是。那我就从呼吸训练开始吧，御堂教练。」
lines.text_en: “...Fair enough. I'll start with the breathing exercises, then, Coach Mido.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「第一项：听见医生说『今天到这里』，就真的停下来。」
lines.text_en: “Lesson one: when the doctor says ‘that's enough for today,’ you actually stop.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「这种项目，我可能比马拉松还不擅长。」
lines.text_en: “I may be worse at that than I ever was at marathons.”

lines.speaker: doc_emiko
lines.text: 「那就练。你最不缺的，不就是耐力吗？」
lines.text_en: “Then practice. Endurance is the one thing you've never lacked, isn't it?”
